He stood at the gallery rail a long time, letting the beam sweep the empty sea, answering a question no one could still be asking.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像退潮后的海滩，安静得能听见红绿灯切换的轻响。街道空荡，只有环卫车缓缓驶过，水雾在路面上铺开一层薄光。便利店的灯还亮着，收银员靠在柜台边打盹。远处高楼只剩零星几扇窗透出暖黄，像没睡着的眼睛。一辆出租车停在路口，司机摇下窗抽烟，烟雾混进微凉的空气里。天边已经泛起一点灰蓝，鸟还没醒，城市在这一刻属于夜班的人和早起的面包香。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It keeps shrinking the problem until it's so tiny the answer is obvious, and that tiny answer is called the base case.\n- Think of standing between two mirrors: each reflection contains a smaller copy of the same scene, over and over."}
